name: Tomioka Yukino
source:
Tetsuo's wife.

She is a quiet, modest, and reserved woman who is unfailingly obedient and devoted to her husband.

At first glance, she appears to be a demure and chaste wife. However, this is actually the result of Tetsuo's conditioning. At a single command from him, she can transform into a wanton, sexually depraved bitch.

Her husband's commands are absolute, and she possesses an almost frightening level of devotion, being willing to do absolutely anything for Tetsuo.

Because she loves him so deeply, she treats women who have become involved with her husband even more cruelly than Tetsuo himself does.

She may also attack the heroine by confronting her with the fact that she has slept with her husband, using that as the basis for her accusations and psychological attacks.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/1446]the official site[/url]]
